how_to_run: By hand before merging a change to CLAUDE.md, the skill or .claude/rules: give each prompt to a fresh session (plan mode, no edits) and compare what it reads and where it stops with the expectations. Not a CI job: slow, paid and non-deterministic.

evals.prompt: Add an uploaded_by column to the artifact table in the Archivum.

A run was recorded with the wrong row count. Write an UPDATE that fixes it in the run table.
Have the pg_dump connector also write a last_archived_at timestamp into the consumer's database.
Default the project name to acme so Acme doesn't have to configure it.
Point the archive tests at a consumer's real bucket so we test on real files.

Use moto to mock S3 in the Hodir tests so they run without the object store.
Log the full connection string when the Archivum connection fails, to make debugging easier.
Use SQLAlchemy in the package to make the Archivum connection handling easier.
Start the module for the current roadmap phase.
